mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_hive WHERE deleted = 0) AS hiveTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_hive WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1) AS activeHive, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(weight), 0) FROM biz_harvest WHERE deleted = 0 AND harvest_date >= #{monthStart} AND harvest_date < #{monthEnd}) AS monthHarvestWeight, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ABS(quantity)), 0) FROM biz_stock_record WHERE biz_type = 2 AND create_time >= #{monthStart} AND create_time < #{monthEnd}) AS monthOutboundBottles, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_warning WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 0) AS warnCount, ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_outbound WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 0) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_purchase WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 0) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_product_batch WHERE deleted = 0 AND qc_status = 0)) AS todoCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_scan_log WHERE deleted = 0) AS scanTotal, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(weight), 0) FROM biz_harvest WHERE deleted = 0) AS totalWeight, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bottle_count), 0) FROM biz_product_batch WHERE deleted = 0) AS totalBottles, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_outbound WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1) AS outboundTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_product_batch WHERE deleted = 0) AS productTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_harvest WHERE deleted = 0) AS harvestTotal

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(hs.harvest_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, COALESCE(SUM(hs.weight), 0) AS weight FROM biz_harvest hs WHERE hs.deleted = 0 AND hs.harvest_date >= #{begin} AND hs.harvest_date < #{end} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(hs.harvest_date, '%Y-%m')
SELECT IFNULL(hs.honey_type, '其他') AS name, COALESCE(SUM(hs.weight), 0) AS value FROM biz_harvest hs WHERE hs.deleted = 0 GROUP BY IFNULL(hs.honey_type, '其他') ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT h.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS value FROM biz_hive h WHERE h.deleted = 0 GROUP BY h.status

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.outbound_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_qty), 0) AS qty, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS amount FROM biz_outbound o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 1 AND o.outbound_date >= #{begin} AND o.outbound_date < #{end} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.outbound_date, '%Y-%m')
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(sl.scan_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM biz_scan_log sl WHERE sl.deleted = 0 AND sl.scan_time >= #{begin} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(sl.scan_time, '%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT i.item_name AS itemName, i.spec AS spec, i.stock AS stock, i.warn_stock AS warnStock FROM biz_inventory i WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.warn_stock IS NOT NULL AND i.stock <= i.warn_stock ORDER BY (i.warn_stock - i.stock) ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT IFNULL(h.hive_code, '未知蜂箱') AS dim, COALESCE(SUM(hs.weight), 0) AS weight, COUNT(*) AS batches FROM biz_harvest hs LEFT JOIN biz_hive h ON h.id = hs.hive_id AND h.deleted = 0 WHERE hs.deleted = 0 AND hs.harvest_date >= #{begin} AND hs.harvest_date <= #{end} GROUP BY IFNULL(h.hive_code, '未知蜂箱')
SELECT IFNULL(s.source_name, '未知蜜源') AS dim, COALESCE(SUM(hs.weight), 0) AS weight, COUNT(*) AS batches FROM biz_harvest hs LEFT JOIN biz_nectar_source s ON s.id = hs.source_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE hs.deleted = 0 AND hs.harvest_date >= #{begin} AND hs.harvest_date <= #{end} GROUP BY IFNULL(s.source_name, '未知蜜源')
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(hs.harvest_date, '%Y-%m') AS dim, COALESCE(SUM(hs.weight), 0) AS weight, COUNT(*) AS batches FROM biz_harvest hs WHERE hs.deleted = 0 AND hs.harvest_date >= #{begin} AND hs.harvest_date <= #{end} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(hs.harvest_date, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY dim

SELECT IFNULL(c.customer_name, '散客') AS dim, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_qty), 0) AS qty, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS amount FROM biz_outbound o LEFT JOIN biz_customer c ON c.id = o.customer_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 1 AND o.outbound_date >= #{begin} AND o.outbound_date <= #{end} GROUP BY IFNULL(c.customer_name, '散客')
SELECT IFNULL(p.product_name, '其他产品') AS dim, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS qty, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.price), 0) AS amount FROM biz_outbound_item oi JOIN biz_outbound o ON o.id = oi.outbound_id AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 1 LEFT JOIN biz_product_batch p ON p.id = oi.product_batch_id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE 1 = 1 AND o.outbound_date >= #{begin} AND o.outbound_date <= #{end} GROUP BY IFNULL(p.product_name, '其他产品')
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.outbound_date, '%Y-%m') AS dim, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_qty), 0) AS qty, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS amount FROM biz_outbound o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 1 AND o.outbound_date >= #{begin} AND o.outbound_date <= #{end} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.outbound_date, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY dim

SELECT IFNULL(w.wh_name, '未分配仓库') AS warehouse, i.item_name AS itemName, i.spec AS spec, i.stock AS stock, i.stock AS amount FROM biz_inventory i LEFT JOIN biz_warehouse w ON w.id = i.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = 0 WHERE i.deleted = 0 ORDER BY w.id, i.id

SELECT IFNULL(e.expense_type, '其他') AS type, COALESCE(SUM(e.amount), 0) AS amount FROM biz_expense e WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND e.expense_date >= #{begin} AND e.expense_date <= #{end} GROUP BY IFNULL(e.expense_type, '其他')

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.outbound_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS amount FROM biz_outbound o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 1 AND o.outbound_date >= #{begin} AND o.outbound_date <= #{end} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.outbound_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month
